Florida Man Faces Execution for 1996 Hog Trail Murders

A Florida man is scheduled to face execution for his role in the 1996 "Hog Trail Murders." The killings occurred in rural Florida, and the man was convicted of a murder connected to the case. He is set to be executed in Florida.
